components_selected.acquisition_method: fetched registry JSON directly with curl, source written to src/vendor/reactbits/DecryptedText.tsx
components_selected.ux_purpose: The citizen's problem statement resolves from scrambled characters into readable text. Visually stages the product's actual claim: an unstructured problem becomes something the system can read. Not decorative motion; it dramatizes the transformation the product performs.
components_selected.why_it_fits: Reinforces uncertainty -> understanding directly at the point where the citizen types, rather than as a separate explainer block.

components_selected.dependency: motion@^12.23.12 (re-implemented on motion instead of the registry's gsap variant, to avoid a second animation library for one component)
components_selected.acquisition_method: concept and API shape taken from the registry component; reimplemented against `motion` to share the single animation dependency already pulled in by DecryptedText and Stepper
components_selected.target_screen: Landing (the failed-portal-exchange reveal), Authority (situation -> meaning -> destination reveal)
components_selected.ux_purpose: Staged reveal: citizen sentence, then the portal's real refusal, then our product's response. Communicates progression, not decoration.
components_selected.why_it_fits: Direct implementation of the required landing story: problem enters as language, system responds.

components_selected.acquisition_method: concept taken from the registry; reimplemented as a lightweight progress-of-understanding indicator on the Authority screen rather than importing the full multi-step-form Stepper (which assumes form-wizard semantics this product's routing does not use)
components_selected.ux_purpose: Visualizes Your situation -> What that means -> Where it belongs as a real sequence rather than a static three-line list, so the recommendation reads as earned rather than dropped in.
components_selected.why_it_fits: Matches the exact structure requested for the authority screen.
components_selected.status: EVALUATED, NOT IMPLEMENTED. Descoped under the one-day timebox after the landing hero (P0) consumed the available time. See docs/evals/component-mutation-testing.md.

components_rejected.name: Dither / Beams / Aurora backgrounds
components_rejected.reason: All require three.js or ogl (WebGL). Adds 150kB+ and a GPU dependency for a background effect on a low-bandwidth-target civic tool. Rejected on the performance/purpose test.

components_rejected.name: SplitText / TextType
components_rejected.reason: Overlaps with DecryptedText's job on the same screen. One text-transformation moment is enough; two competes for attention.

components_rejected.name: GooeyNav / BubbleMenu / FlowingMenu
components_rejected.reason: Navigation decoration with no role in a linear, six-step citizen journey.

components_rejected.name: SpotlightCard / TiltedCard / GlareHover
components_rejected.reason: Card-hover embellishment with no connection to the product's actual claim; the anti-slop test (would this look identical with the branding removed?) fails.
